school.name: Schuylerville Preparatory High School
school.overview: Schuylerville Preparatory High School is a small school with a big heart that serves scholars from grades 9-12. Our community supports scholars holistically, with specific attention to academics, collaboration, and self-advocacy. Our goal is to get scholars Real-World-Ready. At SPHS, scholars receive individualized attention that enables them to explore their interests and develop goals, while engaging in rigorous curricula across all disciplines. Our course offerings include Advanced Placement (AP) courses in English and Biology, participation in campus-wide AP courses across all subject areas, electives in journalism, communications, environmental science and mathematics, and a partnership with College Now programs at Lehman College and at Bronx Community College.
